changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','CLIENT_PROFORMAS'), ('MANAGER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS'), ('BUYER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS'), ('FINANCIER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS'), ('CLIENT','CLIENT_PROFORMAS'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS'), ('BUYER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS'), ('MANAGER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS'), ('FINANCIER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS') ) g(role_code, res_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','READ'), ('ADMIN','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','DELETE'), ('MANAGER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','CREATE'), ('MANAGER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','READ'), ('MANAGER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','DELETE'), ('BUYER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','READ'), ('FINANCIER','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','READ'), ('CLIENT','CLIENT_PROFORMAS','READ'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','READ'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','DELETE'), ('ADMIN','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','APPROVE'), ('BUYER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','CREATE'), ('BUYER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','READ'), ('BUYER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','UPDATE'), ('BUYER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','DELETE'), ('MANAGER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','READ'), ('FINANCIER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','READ'), ('FINANCIER','EXTERNAL_ORDERS','APPROVE') ) g(role_code, res_code, op_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = g.op_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM (VALUES ('FINANCIER','NOTIFICATIONS'), ('FINANCIER','MATERIAL_SELLERS'), ('FINANCIER','VAT_RATES'), ('FINANCIER','MEASUREMENT_UNITS') ) g(role_code, res_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM (VALUES ('FINANCIER','MATERIAL_SELLERS','READ'), ('FINANCIER','VAT_RATES','READ'), ('FINANCIER','MEASUREMENT_UNITS','READ') ) g(role_code, res_code, op_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = g.op_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT frr.id, brro.operation_id FROM role_resources brr JOIN roles br ON br.id = brr.role_id AND br.code = 'BUYER' JOIN resources res ON res.id = brr.resource_id AND res.code = 'NOTIFICATIONS' JOIN role_resource_operations brro ON brro.role_resource_id = brr.id JOIN roles fr ON fr.code = 'FINANCIER' JOIN role_resources frr ON frr.role_id = fr.id AND frr.resource_id = res.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = frr.id AND x.operation_id = brro.operation_id );
